howItWorksProcess.title: Study AI in three simple moves.
howItWorksProcess.description: Upload materials, set your goal, and get a schedule with practice decks and quizzes that update as you learn. Study AI keeps the workload realistic for your calendar.

step-1.title: Add your materials in seconds.
step-1.description: Drop notes, slides, or a syllabus and Study AI pulls out the topics, definitions, and exam dates. You can also paste a prompt if you only have a rough outline. Tag the class, choose a deadline, and you are ready.

step-2.title: Build the plan and practice.
step-2.description: Study AI builds a weekly plan plus a flashcards maker deck and a quiz maker set for every module. It spaces reviews so hard topics come back more often. Adjust the pace or rearrange sessions before you start.

step-3.title: Review, test, and adapt daily.
step-3.description: Each session ends with quick checks and explanations, then Study AI reshuffles tomorrow based on accuracy and time. You always know what to do next. Over time the plan gets shorter and sharper.

card-1.title: Study AI Notes to Mastery
card-1.description: Condense lectures into clean notes and key takeaways so you can review fast.
subtext: Study AI highlights core definitions, formulas, and relationships, then groups them into quick-scan sections.
Keep the source attached to every note so you can jump back to the full reading for context.
Add your own highlights and the next session updates automatically.

card-2.title: Flashcards maker that adapts
card-2.description: Turn your notes into spaced-repetition decks that update as you learn.
subtext: The flashcards maker pulls terms, concepts, and examples, then organizes decks by chapter or exam date.
As you answer, Study AI adjusts intervals and creates extra cards for weak spots so recall improves faster.
Mix new cards with reviews so old material stays fresh right before tests.

card-3.title: Quiz maker for real recall
card-3.description: Build short quizzes from each topic so you practice what you forget.
subtext: The quiz maker blends multiple choice, short answer, and applied scenarios with instant feedback.
Study AI tracks accuracy, rewrites missed questions, and recommends the next session automatically.
Export quizzes or share them with a study group when you want a quick check-in.

card-4.title: Adaptive study plan, not a static checklist
card-4.description: Map the semester and let the plan flex with your calendar.
subtext: Study AI spreads topics across weeks, then adjusts sessions when you miss a day or change a deadline.
See the next seven days at a glance and drag sessions to match real life.
Every plan stays tied to your flashcards maker decks and quiz maker practice.

card-5.title: Session briefs that keep you focused
card-5.description: Open a session and see what matters most in minutes.
subtext: Each session starts with a crisp brief: goals, estimated time, and the exact materials to review.
Study AI keeps long readings short by surfacing the pieces linked to today's cards and quizzes.

card-6.title: Progress and weak-spot insights
card-6.description: Track accuracy, time, and topic coverage across every class.
subtext: Study AI surfaces weak areas early, then schedules extra review before they hurt your score.
Weekly summaries show what improved, what stalled, and which topics are ready to drop.

gallery.title: See it at work across subjects.
gallery.description: From biology to law, Study AI keeps every class organized in one clean workspace. Split by semester, exam, or project and keep all progress in one place. Switch between courses without losing momentum or context.

faqProcess.title: Study AI questions, answered.
faqProcess.description: Everything you need to know about Study AI, the flashcards maker, and the quiz maker.

item-1.question: What is Study AI and who is it for?
item-1.answer: Study AI is a study copilot for students, professionals, and anyone preparing for exams or certifications. It turns your materials into a personalized plan, flashcards, and quizzes so you can learn with less friction.

item-2.question: Is the flashcards maker spaced repetition?
item-2.answer: Yes. The flashcards maker uses spaced repetition and adapts intervals. When you miss a card, it comes back sooner and may be rephrased with an example so the concept sticks. You can edit or delete any card before a session starts.

item-3.question: How does the quiz maker work?
item-3.answer: The quiz maker builds short, focused quizzes from your notes and goals. It mixes question types, explains answers, and adjusts difficulty so you stay challenged without getting stuck. You can retake missed questions or generate fresh variants whenever you want.

item-4.question: What can I upload to Study AI?
item-4.answer: You can add notes, slides, PDFs, or pasted text. Study AI extracts topics, definitions, and examples, then organizes them into sessions you can complete daily.

item-5.question: Does Study AI replace my notes?
item-5.answer: No. Study AI keeps your original sources and builds a study layer on top of them. You can jump back to the full reading at any time, and you stay in control of what gets included or ignored. Think of it as structure, not a replacement.

item-6.question: Can I track progress and weak spots?
item-6.answer: Yes. Study AI tracks accuracy, time, and topic coverage, then highlights weak areas before they hurt your score. Your plan automatically reshuffles so you spend more time on what actually needs work. Weekly summaries show what improved and what still needs attention.

item-7.question: How long does it take to see results?
item-7.answer: Most learners notice clearer recall within the first week because the sessions are shorter and more targeted. The more you use it, the faster it adapts to your pace.

item-8.question: Is there a free plan?
item-8.answer: Yes. You can start free and build your first plan, flashcards, and quizzes. Upgrade only when you need more sessions, larger decks, or deeper analytics. The free plan is perfect for trying one course or a short sprint.

item-9.question: Can I use Study AI for group study?
item-9.answer: You can share plans and export decks or quizzes to study together. Group features are improving, but you already have a clean way to sync what everyone should review. Shared sets stay aligned when you update your materials.
